jailbreak.title: A jailbreak is required before the device can join Pocket
jailbreak.body: Pocket Studio can jailbreak the iPod touch 4 with the Legacy iOS Kit ramdisk method: untethered and without erasing data. The flow explains every risk and asks you to confirm each one before guiding you into DFU mode.
jailbreak.point1: No data is erased, but a backup is still strongly recommended.
jailbreak.point2: The Power and Home buttons must both work.
jailbreak.point3: Do not unplug the cable or let the computer sleep. The whole flow takes about 5 minutes.

guidance.ready: All requirements are met. Head to the App Store to install the Pocket runtime.
